package.parent_binding: parent_live_state names the CURRENT live release (Fayetteville, deploy 6aa750d8...). That is what this package was validated against. Once Jacksonville is live, FAST rule N fails this package BY DESIGN; the registration order -- after Jacksonville, Greenville, Atlanta, Outer Banks AND Boone - Blowing Rock are live -- re-seals the same committed inputs against that parent as a NEW package id. Nothing here is a production candidate, and no whole-site build was assembled.
